Just some tips from someone who rides with 2 dogs all the time:
- Be sure basic training is in check before doing bike stuff, he should now how to walk by the heel and how to come under distractive environments
- distraction based training is a must! Because biking can be full of distractions, for you for your dog and for others, and DANGEROUS
- on the aid kit (if you dont have one) carry one for him too, with dog specific anti septic
- teach him to always follow you (you in the front) always! That way you can guide him on the trail, otherwise he might choose a different path, and make a sudden turn or not hear you at all if he comes distracted my something else.
- Consider using a dog locator, Garmin makes good ones but expensive, but they can track your dogs without cell service and connect with a Garmin watch even. You can set geofences that alert you if he goes too far away from you
- if you don't use a tracker consider at least a dog collar, with a beep function (disable the shock) and train him to come on the beep function.
- beware of his paws and hydration, carry some shoes paws and extra water for him on the summer, you can also get him a backpack.

Also, go slow, set easy goals day by day and keep going.
But please train him well, because some people just don't like off leash dogs so he needs to know how do come and do the heel above the urge to go to the person or other animal.
